race.comment: BLISS BOMB (4) had an excuse for a fair run last start, and is over that issue after winning a recent jump-out since that effort just over 6 weeks ago. The winkers are on for the first time, and she can make amends. LE NOTRE (1) ended her 3YO season on a winning note at Pakenham when showing a quick turn of foot to score easily over 1200m. She will be hoping to hold her spot from the pole position fresh up, and is well worth each-way consideration. SUGAR SCHNAPPS (3) dropped down to this level third up and improved to finish a sound runner-up as the favourite at Tatura a fortnight ago. She carries 2kg less this time, and won't be far away. VIZIE (6) resumes over a trip short of her best, so look for her late. ASMITA (7) won't lack fitness and should be included.
